Question
========
Why does the module refer to Harari's argument about stories?

Answerlist
----------
* Because inequality is sustained and contested through shared narratives such as meritocracy or market freedom
* Because inequality data are invented
* Because monkeys and humans have the same sense of fairness
* Because only historians can explain inequality

Solution
========
Harari argues that humans cooperate by believing in shared stories. Hierarchies, too, rest on stories that people accept or reject.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
